title: Cart badge shows wrong count
locked_flow:
Open http://localhost:3000/cart. Verify the cart shows "Cart is empty" and the header cart badge shows 0.
Go to http://localhost:3000/ and click the "Add shirt to cart" button exactly 3 times in total, one click after another. Do not repeat, retry, or add clicks based on the cart badge or any other page state; the badge must never be used as a loop or stop condition.
Without reloading or leaving the page, verify the header cart badge shows exactly 3.
Open the cart page. Verify the Settled Tee row shows a quantity of exactly 3.
Verify the cart total is exactly $54.00.
guard_flow:
Open http://localhost:3000/cart. Verify the cart shows "Cart is empty" and the header cart badge shows 0.
Go to http://localhost:3000/ and click the "Add shirt to cart" button exactly 3 times in total. Do not add clicks based on the cart badge or any other page state.
Open the cart page. Verify the Settled Tee row shows a quantity of exactly 3 and the cart total is exactly $54.00.
Click Checkout. Verify the checkout summary lists 3 × Settled Tee and the order total is exactly $54.00.
Click "Place order". Verify the order confirmation shows a charged amount of exactly $54.00.
revision_note: v3: unconditional setup steps. v2 guard runs on the fixed app were inconclusive twice because Kane ran the conditional empty-cart setup out of order. Target assertions unchanged.

baseline_expectations.locked: the header cart badge shows exactly 3

activation.rule: Bounty may move from draft to open only when the unfixed demo shop makes BOTH flows fail as assertion_error.confirmed_product_bug on their declared target check (baseline_expectations).
